correctness.rationale: Exact gap classes for Lyndon substrings with 0–3 ones are mutually disjoint; the three-one condition is the strict maximal cyclic zero-gap tuple, including the equality boundary a=b>c. Seven weak-order and six strict-order geometric series partition all gaps to give the rational bivariate function. Dirichlet sector coordinates yield the limiting distribution and rational first and second moments. Direct string-level enumeration passed 1,365 input words, complete coefficient counts passed through m=25 (23,751 words), and exact rational moments passed. Finite tests corroborate the complete written symbolic proof.

value.rationale: An exact rational bivariate histogram resolves an all-length fixed-content complexity distribution, not merely a textbook single-word example or scalar extremal bound. The six-sector limiting law and exact moments identify typical behavior, filling a fixed-composition gap left by unrestricted Lyndon-factor average/extremal literature. The specificity is motivated by the first sparse case in which three consecutive marked symbols introduce nontrivial tie-dependent rotation order.
